sections.title: Main text
sections.summary: The main text reports the \(\Gamma\) expansion of \(\sigma_{abc}\) and the compact kinetic and geometric formulae. Several displayed equations are the \(f_0\) form of appendix results.

sections.title: Appendix A
sections.summary: Appendix A defines the open-system Hamiltonian and expands the NESS density matrix in the driving perturbation. Bath integrals that produce polygamma functions are recorded; they are not lowered to exact local residuals in this audit.

sections.title: Appendix B
sections.summary: Appendix B expands the Peierls substitution and the current, then forms \(\sigma_{abc}(\omega_1,\omega_2)\) and takes the DC limit. Remainder and limit claims stay at their frozen statuses.

sections.title: Appendix C
sections.summary: Appendix C expands the second-order kernels in \(\Gamma\). Those expansions are inventoried as remainder claims. Finite coefficient identities are not a general remainder certificate.

sections.title: Appendix D
sections.summary: Appendix D expands the nonlinear conductivity in powers of \(\Gamma\) and reorganizes the \(\Gamma^{-2}\), \(\Gamma^{-1}\), and \(\Gamma^{0}\) contributions into kinetic and geometric terms.

sections.title: Appendix E
sections.summary: Appendix E repeats the DC calculation for a generic multiband model. Several steps are definitions or integration-by-parts parents certified by rule rather than by a global integral ZERO.

sections.title: Appendix F
sections.summary: Appendix F recovers the DC conductivity from the low-frequency limit of second-harmonic generation. The SHG \(\Gamma\) expansion is an author-declared remainder claim.

sections.title: Appendix G
sections.summary: Appendix G compares the fermionic-bath model with RTA/IFR. The comparison uses additional approximations; those steps are not promoted to engine ZERO.
